memories.text: Neth planting the hedge along the east path, laughing at how crooked it went. It is still crooked.
The winter fever. The sound the house made afterwards, which was nothing.
Wren on the road out, not looking back. I did not call after her. I should have.
Forty-one harvests. The good ones blur together. The bad ones I can name.
Turned the east rows. The soil is behaving.
Sat with Odile. Comfortable quiet, mostly.
Went to the temple and asked for word from my daughter Wren. Said it out loud, which was harder than expected.

memories.text: The inside of the cart. Straw, and a red blanket, and being told not to look out.
Old Marrow teaching me which fever-leaf is which by making me chew the wrong one first.
The year the well went brackish and I fixed it, and nobody noticed, which is how you know it worked.
Ledger, page one: "Things I do not know." It is the longest page.
Cleared the well and wrote the water level in the ledger.
Waited at the square a while. Nobody came by.

Water is a little lower than last week. Noted it.
Spoke with Tam at the square. News, weather, nothing.
The river at night. I was four. I remember being carried away from the bank, not toward it.
Eating at a different house every night for six years. Everyone was kind. Nobody was mine.
The water-wheel turning for the first time. It ran eight days. Best eight days.
Bram let me sharpen his scythe once and said it was "not bad". I think about that a lot.
The axe head is loose again. Wedged it with a shim. It will hold or it will not.
